Follow me in Instagram @taufulou

This is not a paid ad. Bought this after saw a review from our famous youtuber Joseph Jermani Some of you requested for this product review Dibea 808 UV Vacuum Cleaner in my instagram and here you go.

Dibea 808 UV Vacuum Cleaner Dust Mite Killer turns out to be quite good as the selling price is around RM 230 - RM 250 and I purchase it at RM 168 with free delivery from China. 

In summary, quite a good product, with powerful suction and UV lights to kill bacteria? Well, it mention there. Dont really have any idea how effective is the UV light. 

Felt that it is quite clean after my sofa cleaning. As shown in the video. 

I purchase it through Lazada. Available in Shopee (http://bit.ly/ShopeeDibea) and other marketplace platform.
